metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Wednesday Morning, November 20, 1895, page 5.

facts.fact: Allen, keeping a saloon on Market street between Sixth and Seventh, fired three shots into the air from the sidewalk at 1 a.m. when two quarrelsome men needed ejecting and no policeman was near
places: Market street between Sixth and Seventh, St. Louis
